What

How Roubic's 24/7 Emergency Line Works

Call {{global.phone}} and a real person answers — live, not a voicemail tree or a bot. After-hours calls route to the on-call dispatch queue, where you get verbal scope and immediate safety guidance on the phone. Crews then mobilize from the Auburn Township yard with crane support, trained climbers, and the full debris-haul fleet.

The distinction that matters: an after-hours call is handled the same way as a daytime call — same dispatch, same crew, same equipment. The only thing we won't do is put people up a tree or on a crane during active high-wind conditions or lightning. Once the weather passes and it's safe, we dispatch aggressively across jobs in priority order.

Why

Four Reasons NE Ohio Calls the 24/7 Line

The emergencies our dispatch queue handles most often across NE Ohio properties.

Tree on the House at 9 p.m.

A trunk through the roof in Pepper Pike or Moreland Hills can't wait for morning. We extract and stabilize the same night.

Driveway Blocked After Midnight

A fallen tree across the only way in or out. We clear access so you can get vehicles moving again.

Holiday-Weekend Failure

Storms don't check the calendar. Holiday and weekend calls reach the same live queue as any weekday.

After-Hours Subcontractor Backup

Landscape and property-management firms use Roubic as their after-hours emergency tree subcontractor.

How

Roubic's 4-Step Emergency Process

From your call to job complete — the same approach whether it's noon or 3 a.m. Full storm workflow on the Storm Damage & Emergency hub.

1

Live Call

A real person answers, captures scope, and gives immediate on-call safety guidance.

Site Assessment

Aaron or the lead arborist walks the access route and documents condition, structure proximity, and risk.

3

4

Cleanup + Walk

Brush chipped, wood rounded, ground raked clean. Final walk-through, then an itemized invoice emailed on completion.

Common Emergency Questions

24/7 Emergency Tree Service FAQ

Five things NE Ohio callers want to know before an emergency hits.

Does Roubic really answer the phone after hours?
Yes — {{global.phone}} is live-answered any hour, any day. After-hours calls route to the on-call dispatch queue. No voicemail trees, no bot answer — a real person picks up and gives you immediate safety guidance on the call.
What's the response time for an after-hours emergency?
Our target on-site window for Tier 1 and Tier 2 markets is 2–4 hours, conditions permitting. Tier 3 markets (Chesterland, Mayfield, South Russell) carry a brief mobilization premium and a typical response of 3–5 hours.
Will Roubic dispatch during an active storm?
No — crew safety prohibits putting climbers or a crane operator to work during active high-wind conditions or lightning. Once conditions are safe (typically 2–4 hours after the storm passes) we dispatch aggressively across multiple jobs in priority order.
Do you charge a premium for after-hours work?
Standard residential and commercial work scheduled outside business hours has no after-hours premium. Active emergency response — a tree on a structure or blocking access — reflects the equipment and crew the job actually needs in the scope quote. Pricing is scope-driven, not surcharge-driven.
Can a landscape or property-management company use Roubic as an after-hours subcontractor?
Yes. Several area landscape and property-management firms already use Roubic as their after-hours emergency tree subcontractor — one documented example was a 9 p.m. dispatch for a partner firm during a 2024 multi-tree storm event in Pepper Pike. B2B subcontractor accounts are welcome.
